description: Natural dithering (shared/DITHER.md). Made by python/tools/natural_vectors.py: from the repository root, PYTHONPATH=python/src python python/tools/natural_vectors.py. tables_sha256: per key of shared/dither/natural-tables.json, the SHA-256 of its values as little-endian binary64 in JSON order (nested lists row by row); the integer keys palette_srgb, sectors, stucki and stucki_div are checked directly. colours: step A of one colour; rgb is hex, target three hex floats, set -1 for grey (candidates black and white) or the sector 0-4. images: rgb is hex, three bytes per pixel, row-major; indices one hex digit per pixel, row-major. frames: rgb_deflate is base64 of the raw DEFLATE (no zlib header) of the width x height x 3 RGB bytes; sha256 is of the width x height indices, one byte each.
